questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit General Medicine & Fatigue Intake
questionnaires.description: Clinical pre-assessment to evaluate daytime drowsiness, fatigue, sleep schedule, and general health indicators.

questions.question: How long have you been experiencing this sleepiness or fatigue?
How many hours do you usually sleep at night?
Do you feel sleepy during the daytime even after what feels like adequate sleep?
Has your sleep schedule, work shift, or stress level changed recently?
Are you experiencing weakness, dizziness, headaches, or difficulty concentrating?
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, sedatives, or over-the-counter drugs?
Has this fatigue or drowsiness caused you to fall asleep while driving or operating machinery?

questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit Orthopedic & Joint Intake
questionnaires.description: Comprehensive musculoskeletal evaluation to assess joint pain, mobility restriction, and prior injuries.

questions.question: Are you experiencing severe numbness, loss of bladder/bowel control, or high fever with joint swelling?
Which joint or region is causing you discomfort?
On a scale of 1 (mild) to 10 (unbearable), how would you rate your current pain?
Did this symptom begin following a specific sports injury, fall, or accident?
Is the discomfort significantly worse while walking, bearing weight, or climbing stairs?

questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit Cardiology Symptom Screening
questionnaires.description: Cardiovascular screening questionnaire to evaluate chest sensations, palpitations, and exertion tolerance.

questions.question: Are you experiencing active crushing chest pressure radiating to your jaw or left arm right now?
What is your primary reason for visiting cardiology?
Do you have a personal history of hypertension or take blood pressure medications?

questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit Neurology Symptom Assessment
questionnaires.description: Pre-consultation neurological questionnaire for Dr. Elena Rostova.

questions.question: Are you experiencing a sudden severe headache, sudden vision loss, difficulty speaking, or weakness on one side of your body?
What is your primary reason for visiting neurology?
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit Dermatology Skin Intake
questionnaires.description: Screening questionnaire for skin rashes, lesions, and dermatological conditions for Dr. Sneha Patel.

questions.question: Where on your body is the rash or lesion located?
When did the rash or lesion first appear?
Is the affected area intensely itchy, burning, painful, or bleeding?
Is the skin condition accompanied by high fever or difficulty breathing?

questionnaires.title: Pre-Visit Neurology Intake — I Have Severe Headache.
questionnaires.description: Please complete this context-specific clinical intake to prepare your chart for your Neurology consultation regarding I have severe headache..

questions.question: Please describe the main symptom or reason for your clinical visit today:
When did you first notice these symptoms?
On a scale of 1 (mild) to 10 (severe), how significantly does this affect your daily routine?
Are you currently taking any prescription medications or over-the-counter drugs?
Are you experiencing any sudden severe pain, high fever, fainting, or difficulty breathing?
